label: Lactobionic acid
note: Potassium lactobionate is the osmotic support in organ-preservation solutions such as Viaspan and CoStorSol.

about.text: A sugar acid formed when the glucose half of lactose is oxidised. Its salts go into organ-transplant preservation fluids, calcium lactobionate is a food stabiliser and mineral source (E399), and the acid is used in cosmetics.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Pseudomonas taetrolens on whey at about 28 °C, pH 6-7 gave the best productivity in a review; 164 g/l in fed-batch with co-feeding (Alonso et al., Bioresource Technology 2013)
Pseudomonas fragi: 3.09 g/l/h, 100 % yield on whey powder with 300 g/l lactose (Wu et al., Microb Cell Fact 2022)
